pinned.title: Lucky Sleuthers — The ARC 25 Have Been Notified
pinned.body:
The ARC request window for The Beautiful Beast is closed. Silver Spine Studio™ has selected twenty-five Lucky Sleuthers for early access, and selection notices have been sent.

If you requested an ARC, please check your email inbox — and look in Junk / Spam as well. Notices went out August 17, 2026 from contact@silverspinestudio.com.

UPDATE — ARC Sneak Peek delivery: October 1–3, 2026 (done). This was the Extended Sneak Peek — Prologue and Chapters 1–2 — not the full novel.

Congratulations from Silver Spine Studio to everyone selected. Thank you to every reader who applied and took part — your support means more than you know.

Please keep an eye on silverspinestudio.com for updates and new release information.

Coming next for Extended Sneak Peek buyers: Gumroad Insider Deal is October 22, 2026 at $14.99. The full DIGITAL file is not ready until November 1 — the same day as the hardcover. Regular digital price is $19.99 from November 1; paperback $24.99; hardcover $29.99.

Questions or concerns? Please reach out anytime at contact@silverspinestudio.com — we are glad to help.

Happy Sleuthing!

pinned.title: The Beautiful Beast — Launch Timeline & What’s Next
pinned.body: The road to release is mapped. Here’s the plan and how to get early access.
bullets: ARC Sneak Peek Oct 1–3 (done · not the full novel)
Launch week Oct 21–28 · Gumroad Insider Deal Oct 22
Official release Nov 1 — full digital file with the hardcover
pinned.expandBody:
Milestones

1. Cover Reveal — Aug 3, 2026. The blank ribbon falls away. The premium artwork is officially unmasked.
2. Sneak Peek Release — Aug 4, 2026. Digital Extended Sneak Peek (Prologue & Chapters 1–2) for $4.99 — live in stores. This purchase places you on the Insider Deal whitelist.
3. ARC Sign-ups — Aug 7 – Aug 14, 2026. Window closed. The 25 Lucky Sleuthers have been chosen and notified (Aug 17).
4. Teaser Trailer 2 Drop — Aug 21, 2026. Production loops push live.
5. ARC Sneak Peek delivery — Oct 1–3, 2026. Done. Prologue & Chapters 1–2 only — not the full novel.
6. Launch Week Events — Oct 21–28, 2026. Site announcements and socials.
7. Gumroad Insider Deal — Oct 22, 2026. $14.99 for whitelisted readers. The full DIGITAL file is not ready until Nov 1.
8. Official Release Day — Nov 1, 2026. Full digital file · paperback $24.99 · hardcover $29.99 · digital retail $19.99.

A note for readers & gift-givers

• Begin with the Sneak Peek: $4.99 for Prologue & Chapters 1–2 — already in stores — and your place on the Insider whitelist.
• Full DIGITAL: Gumroad Insider Deal Oct 22 at $14.99; the file arrives Nov 1 with the hardcover. Then $19.99 from Nov 1, 2026. Paperback $24.99. Hardcover $29.99.
• Holiday timing: Nov 1 release lands just as gift season begins — a Colorado thriller ready for the nightstand, the stocking, or the reader who loves a storm.
